items.title: feat: open shared sessions in their source Control UI (#203044)
items.summary: feat: open shared sessions in their source Control UI (#203044) * feat: open shared sessions in their source Control UI * feat: open shared sessions in their source Control UI OpenClaw-Publication: a3826b6b-5899-8ff2-a1b5-84961c64219f * Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into land/open-original-203044 * origin/main: fix(ci): decouple boundary fixture from timing inventory (#203026) fix(ci): shard capable compatibility UI targets (#203042) perf(agents): restore selected subagent payloads once (#203039) fix: keep standalone context from completing QA tool steps perf(sessions): reuse sealed ownership for context projections (#203040) refactor(hooks): separate event predicates from hook registry (#203017) fix(ci): align update export audits with their consumers (#203030) fix: keep cold baseline checks within the existing heap limit * fix(session-share): accept the runtime config snapshot in the source link resolver The stored-session link resolver took a mutable config, so the plugin's readonly runtime snapshot failed production and test typechecks. Accept the snapshot type. Document the real Open original setup: allow the link command on the receiver Gateway, set the source Control UI origin, reinstall the source node with all three commands, then approve the widened surface. Move the section ahead of Security boundary and add a troubleshooting entry. Assert through the Gateway catalog list that a provider-supplied link survives streamed and final rows, and drop the menu unit test the browser fixture covers. * Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into land/open-original-203044 * origin/main: refactor(test): remove duplicate token startup wait case (#203087) fix: keep Plugin SDK declarations within the build limit fix(ci): remove unused hook type exports (#203074) fix(test): exercise the sign-in callback path guard (#203075) refactor(tts): separate caption eligibility from text helpers (#203068) test: reuse worker preload options (#203058) refactor(test): share Bun native-policy test launcher (#203064) fix(cron): a chat-created automation's failure notice reaches that chat (#203056) refactor(test): remove duplicate claw origin rejection case (#203067) refactor(channels): move chunk-mode lookup to streaming readers (#203047) refactor: separate skill queries from workspace discovery (#203045) fix: resume new chat turns in retained tasks after a restart refactor: separate usage pricing preparation from formatting (#203043) fix: avoid repeated filesystem probes before agent turns (#203057) perf(agents): preserve sealed history during endpoint compaction (#203037) fix(test): give deferred identity fixtures read scope (#203053) refactor(test): remove redundant channel catalog facade (#203052) refactor(cli): isolate daemon port presentation (#203020) refactor(cron): isolate CLI input parsing (#203031) * chore(plugin-sdk): record the approved session-discussion surface growth Open original adds two exports to openclaw/plugin-sdk/session-discussion: the stored-session Control UI path resolver and the session path parser. Raise the public export and callable budgets by two for them. Use neutral fixtures for the rejected-origin and rejected-query URL tests so the fixtures do not resemble credentials; the same rejections are covered. Co-authored-by: Vincent Koc Co-authored-by: vincentkoc
